m: कारोती f. N. of a river or of a locality, ŚBr. ix, 5, 2, 15.

a: कारोत(त्त)मः --रः — Ved. 1 A filtering vessel. --2 Yeast, barm. --3 A well.

m: कारोतर अस्, m. a filtering vessel or a cloth used to purify the liquor called Surā, RV. i, 116, 7; VS.; ŚBr. &c.

s: puM, (kAreRa surAgAlanena uttamaH । maRqasya uttamatayA taTAtvam .) kArottaraH । ityamarawIkAyAM svAmI ॥
m: कारोत्तम m. the froth of Surā, L.

s: puM, (kAreRa surAgAlanakriyayA uttarati । ut + tF + ac .) surAgraBAgaH । tatparyyAyaH । surAmaRqaH 2 । ityamaraH । 2 । 10 । 43 ॥ kUpaH । iti hArAvalI ॥
v: pu॰ kAreRa surAgAlanakriyayA uttarati ud + tFac । 1 surAmaRqe amaraH svAmI tu kArottama iti paWitvA tatrArTe ityAha surAgAlana kriyAyAM maRqasyottamatvAttaTAtvam । kAreRa IzadgatyA uttIryate'sO ud + tF--karmaRi ap । 2 kUpe halA॰ tadDetutvAt cAlanIrUpe vaMSAdije 3 pAtraBede । “antara uttaravedyA rUpaM kArottaroBizak” yaju॰ 19, 16 । kArottaraH surApAvanacAlanI” vedadI॰ “asTi majjAnaM mAsarEH kArottareRa” yaju॰ 19, 82 । susAgAlanI cAlanI ca vaMSamayI tayA yajYiyasurAgAlanaprakAraH kAtyA॰ SrO॰ 19, 2, 7, sU॰ darSitoyaTA । SvaBraM KAtvA svaramapareRa carmAvaDAya parisrutamAsicya kArottaramavadaDAti, kArottarAdvA carmmaRi mantraliNgAt pUtAmAdatte siYcanti pariziYcantIti” । “tato dakziRavedisvaramapareRa bahirvedi SvaBraM garttaM KAtvA tatra gartte gocarmmAvaDAya parisruta surAM carmmaRi Asicya surAyA upari kArottaraM vaMSamayaM pAtra (karottaraScAlanikA) surAgAlanasarmaTaM nidaDAti evaM kfte malastale tizWati galitA surA kArottarasyoparyyAyAti eko'yaM gAlano pAyaH । aTavA pUrvvaM carmmaRi kArottaramavaDAya tatra surAmAsiYcati taTA ca sati kArottarAt carmmaRi surA patati” saM॰ vyA॰ । “tasya lomAnyeva puzpARi, tvak tokmAni, mAMsaM lAjA asTi kArottaro majjA mAsaraM rasaH parisrunnagrahurlohitaM, retaH payaH, sUtraM surovaDyam valkasam” Sata॰ brA॰ 12, 9, 1, 2 । evaM kArottaraSabdasya cAlanIparatve sTite surAmaRqasya tatsADyatvAt taTAtvaM boDyam ।
m: 2. कारोत्तर mfn. followed by कार, TPrāt.

k.v: सन्धानं स्यादभिषवः किण्वं पुंसि तु नग्नहूः। कारोत्तरः सुरामण्ड आपानं पानगोष्ठिका॥
